Output contains 'Scope' section
Output contains 'Capabilities' section
Output contains 'Dependency Map' section
Output contains 'Open Questions' section
Output contains 'Research Suggestions' section
Output contains 'Next Steps' section

Each capability has an Inputs field
Each capability has a Logic flow field
Each capability has an Outputs field
Each capability has an Edge cases field
Each capability has a Connects to field

User problem is stated in Problem Statement
Success criteria are measurable
